entries.title: Vibe coding as a delivery process
entries.reviewHint: Check that a spec, a plan and evidence exist; a vague prompt followed by a quick visual look is not delivery.

entries.title: Implementing before understanding the repository
entries.reviewHint: Look for duplicated components, parallel patterns and unnecessary dependencies.

entries.title: One mega-prompt for the whole feature
entries.reviewHint: Check that analysis, architecture, UX, implementation and validation ran as separate stages.

entries.title: Tests written to confirm the existing code
entries.reviewHint: Ask whether each test states a requirement or only describes what the code happens to do.

entries.title: All tests pass without evidence
entries.reviewHint: Require the list of tests that ran, their results and what stayed unvalidated.

entries.title: Snapshots as a substitute for behaviour
entries.reviewHint: Ask what behaviour each snapshot protects and who reviewed its updates.

entries.title: Fragile end-to-end selectors
entries.reviewHint: Prefer role and label queries that reflect what users perceive.

entries.title: Opportunistic refactoring outside the scope
entries.reviewHint: Check that every changed file serves an acceptance criterion of the task.

entries.title: Dependencies added for convenience
entries.reviewHint: Check whether the existing stack already solves the problem.

entries.title: Inventing contracts
entries.reviewHint: Compare mocks and clients with the real contract files and operations.

entries.title: Confusing a pretty design with complete UX
entries.reviewHint: Look for error, loading, keyboard, mobile, extreme-content and feedback states.

entries.title: Self-approval in the same context
entries.reviewHint: Require an independent review session for relevant changes.

entries.title: Simplifying or omitting elements
entries.reviewHint: Compare the reference inventory with the DOM and look for silently substituted assets.

entries.title: Positioning the whole page by coordinates
entries.reviewHint: Test with other content and viewports; structure should come from grid, flex or flow.

entries.title: Fixed heights plus hidden overflow
entries.reviewHint: Check expansion, long text and zoom.

entries.title: Hiding document overflow as a fix
entries.reviewHint: Find the element that overflows instead of clipping the page.

entries.title: Responsive design as proportional shrinking
entries.reviewHint: Check that structure and actions change by width, not only sizes.

entries.title: Validating only the nominal width
entries.reviewHint: Test breakpoint edges, narrow widths and long content.

entries.title: Visual order apart from semantic order
entries.reviewHint: Review the DOM order and the focus order.

entries.title: Arbitrary values for every component
entries.reviewHint: Require approved tokens and a documented exception.

entries.title: Compensating fonts with padding
entries.reviewHint: Verify the font file, loading, weight and line height before adjusting geometry.

entries.title: A div instead of a button
entries.reviewHint: Use a native control or a complete accessible pattern.

entries.title: Interactions that only look real
entries.reviewHint: Run the task and check the result; declare a demo when nothing is connected.

entries.title: Only the ideal state
entries.reviewHint: Review the state matrix and extreme data before closing.

entries.title: Removing or hiding focus
entries.reviewHint: Check visible focus against sticky headers and overlays.

entries.title: Clipped modal or popover
entries.reviewHint: Review anchoring, container, stacking context and focus management.

entries.title: Mobile that deletes functions
entries.reviewHint: Require an explicit access strategy; do not hide features to pass a capture.

entries.title: Dark theme by colour inversion
entries.reviewHint: Use semantic roles and validated pairs per theme.

entries.title: Contradictory CSS or undetectable dynamic Tailwind
entries.reviewHint: Inspect compiled CSS and computed styles; write complete class names.

entries.title: Depending on libraries that are not installed
entries.reviewHint: Inspect dependencies, versions and APIs before implementing.

entries.title: Repeated markup with inconsistent variants
entries.reviewHint: Reuse when behaviour and contract match; avoid premature abstraction.

entries.title: Approving by self-description
entries.reviewHint: Require independent evidence artifacts; report BLOCKED when verification is unavailable.

entries.title: Interchangeable composition
entries.reviewHint: Choose the structure by task; keep a conventional pattern when it works.

entries.title: Marketing hero inside a tool
entries.reviewHint: Use a compact header with the action visible; reserve a hero for an offer or an experience.

entries.title: Every datum in a card
entries.reviewHint: Use a table, a list or relation groups; keep cards for independent units.

entries.title: Nested decorative containers
entries.reviewHint: Flatten the grouping; keep functional nesting such as a panel with controls.

entries.title: Ornaments louder than the task
entries.reviewHint: Reduce effects or give them a purpose and a bounded area.

entries.title: Everything equally prominent
entries.reviewHint: Define an attention order with differences in size, weight, space or colour.

entries.title: Palette chosen by reflex
entries.reviewHint: Justify families by identity and roles; do not change an approved palette because of fashion.

entries.title: Elegance through faint text
entries.reviewHint: Keep contrast and legibility; check real backgrounds and states.

entries.title: Typography without criteria or substituted
entries.reviewHint: Load the approved family and real weights and define roles; do not ban a font only because it is common.

entries.title: Large headings with extreme tracking
entries.reviewHint: Tune by typeface, length and viewport; use expressive display type only where it fits.

entries.title: Every control looks like a chip
entries.reviewHint: Differentiate appearance by behaviour; give equal functions equal shapes.

entries.title: Mixed or oversized icons
entries.reviewHint: Use one family, scale and stroke; add icons only when they help recognition.

entries.title: Filler image or stereotyped metaphor
entries.reviewHint: Use specific content; decoration may set a tone if it does not interfere.

entries.title: Generic or repeated copy
entries.reviewHint: Use concrete task language and contextual help where it removes doubt.

entries.title: Invented figures, clients or testimonials
entries.reviewHint: A failure when presented as real; use verified content or an identified demo.

entries.title: Uniform spacing for different relations
entries.reviewHint: Use less distance inside a group and more between groups; respect the system.

entries.title: Excess emptiness to look sophisticated
entries.reviewHint: Match density to the user; use deliberate space in editorial or brand contexts.

entries.title: Continuous motion without meaning
entries.reviewHint: Signal relevant changes; respect user preferences and motion criteria.

entries.title: Humanising with random imperfections
entries.reviewHint: Express personality through content and direction; allow irregularity only in authorised assets.

entries.title: Swapping one cliche for another
entries.reviewHint: Choose from the brief, not in opposition to a list of banned styles.
